blocks.title: Hybridization
blocks.text: Woh amal jis mein thori mukhtalif energies aur shaklon ke atomic orbitals mil kar ek jaisi energy aur ek jaisi shakal ke barabar orbitals ka naya set banate hain.

items: Hybridization ek akele atom (ya ion) mein orbitals milane ka amal hai.
Sirf qareebi (nisbatan nazdeek) energies ke orbitals mil kar hybrid orbitals bana sakte hain.
Milne wale orbitals ki tadaad hamesha banne wale hybrid orbitals ki tadaad ke barabar hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Carbon ka 2s orbital aur us ke 2p orbitals hybridize ho sakte hain, magar us ka 1s orbital un mein shamil nahi hota. Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Sirf qareebi energy ke orbitals milte hain. 2s aur 2p orbitals energy mein qareeb hain, to woh barabar hybrids mein mil sakte hain; 1s orbital energy mein un se bohat neeche hai aur waisa hi rehta hai.

items: Hybridization ek atom ke energy mein qareeb orbitals ko utni hi tadaad ke barabar energy aur shakal wale hybrid orbitals mein milati hai.
